content:
Jordan: Heads-up  new Senior ML Infra joiner starts Mon 9am PT. Need: a very small week0 agenda, a one-page candidate summary (send with offer), and a manager-facing 30/60/90 checklist. Rhea can you draft?
Rhea: On it. Quick clarifiers: remote or office first day? buddy? laptop imaging status? NDA for datasets?
Jordan: Remote-first but they may come onsite Wed. Buddy assigned = Kai (mornings). IT says laptop imaging possible Fri if asset tag sent today. Legal needs NDA before dataset access.
Kai: I can do 09:00-09:30 PT daily pairing first 2 weeks. Will add a recurring "how to run tests locally" calendar note.
Rhea: Proposed ultra-lean week0 (designed for remote-first):
Mon AM: Welcome call (15m) + account handoff (Okta/Slack/Email) + confirm workstation shipping/tracking
Mon PM: Team intro (30m demo) + quick repo pairing to get dev env green
Tue: Code tour + assign first micro-task (small README fix + unit test)
Wed: Optional office meet & greet (if local) OR deep-dive on infra architecture (remote)
Thu: Observability & runbooks (Grafana, tracing) + security primer (NDA check)
Fri: 30m manager sync (outcomes + blockers) + buddy retro + plan for week2
Rhea: Minimal pre-provision list for IT/Infra: laptop image, Okta + SSO, Slack invite, GitHub org membership, CI write, k8s namespace + canary deploy service account, read-only prod metrics, share Grafana dashboard, Redwood Console dev role.
IT-bot: Ticket created: #9102 (laptop image + Okta + GH invite). Owner: IT.
legal-bot: NDA required for dataset access. Link will be included in candidate email template.
Jordan: For the candidate one-pager keep it friendly and short  1/2 page max. Include: 30/60/90 bullets, top 3 contacts (buddy, manager, infra owner), how success looks at each stage, and the NDA link.
Rhea: Draft candidate one-pager text (single paragraph):
"Welcome! In your first 30 days we expect your dev environment set up and 1-2 small PRs merged; by 60 days you should be owning a non-peak deploy and participating in incident postmortems; by 90 days you'll be independently deploying, proposing a perf or cost improvement, and presenting a short tech update. Your buddy is Kai (morning pairing), manager is Jordan, infra owner is Lina. Please sign the NDA (link) to unlock dataset access."
Rhea: Manager-facing 30/60/90 (concise actionable checklist):
- Week0: accounts confirmed, daily 15m manager check-ins, buddy pairing in calendar, assign 3 micro-tasks with explicit acceptance criteria, NDA gated items flagged.
- 30d: environment fully configured, 2 small PRs merged (one testable change + one doc/README), can run full test suite locally or in CI, buddy feedback collected, manager submits formative note.
- 60d: owns deploys for a non-peak window (canary flow), runs incident playbook under supervision, contributes to a perf/observability ticket.
- 90d: independent deploys + leads a 20m tech sync presenting a proposed improvement tied to service OKR, recommended plan for next 90 days.
Rhea: Manager quick tips (one-liners to add to packet):
- Reserve 15m daily for week0 (focus on blockers), schedule 30m end-of-week review, set concrete acceptance criteria for micro-tasks, invite buddy to manager review at week1, document feedback in hiring tracker.
Jordan: Add an "in-office day" note: if the new hire comes onsite, schedule a short tour + badge setup + lunch with team on Wed. Also confirm workstation docking station order if they're hybrid.
Kai: I'll prepare a "first 48h pairing checklist" and attach links to runbook + test scripts in the calendar invites.
people-ops-bot: Onboarding packet drafted: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/1852000456 (auto-generated).
Rhea: I'll post the two final artifacts (candidate one-pager + manager 30/60/90 doc) here in plain text within 2 hours for sign-off. Tagging Kai + IT + Legal for confirmations.
Jordan: Great work  once posted I'll review and hiring manager will send to candidate. :thumbsup:
